default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-1528.title: Mature-edge box break fade
E-1528.hypothesis: When both edges of the short box have not moved for a long stretch, range traders have had time to rest orders at them and the book on the far side is deep; the first close beyond such an old edge mostly triggers the stops parked there and then meets that resting inventory, so fade it.

E-1529.title: Grinding new-extreme reversal
E-1529.hypothesis: A run in which a large share of recent bars each print a new session high (low) by small steps is late buyers chasing with no fresh size behind them; the first close below the previous bar's low (above its high) shows the chase stopped, and those chasers become sellers, so trade the reversal.

E-1530.title: Wide initial-balance day box-break fade
E-1530.hypothesis: In Market Profile reading, a first hour whose range is wide versus the last 20 sessions' first hours means the larger players already set the day's boundaries early, which usually gives a range day; later short box breaks inside such a day are rotations that responsive traders fade, so fade them.

E-1531.title: Quiet-day-so-far box-break fade
E-1531.hypothesis: When the session's volume so far is below the usual volume at this minute, institutions are not working orders and the tape is day-trader inventory; a short box break then has no large initiator to carry it and the liquidity providers lean it back into the box, so fade it.

E-1532.title: VWAP-centred box break fade
E-1532.hypothesis: A short box with the session VWAP sitting well inside it is the market rotating around fair value, where both sides are content; a close out of such a box is a rotation's edge, not a new value search, and the value traders bring it back, so fade it.

E-1533.title: Multi-touch edge stop-run fade
E-1533.hypothesis: An edge tested by several bars collects a visible cluster of stops just beyond it; the close through it is mostly those stops being filled by the participants who rested liquidity there, and once the cluster is spent nobody is left to extend the move, so fade the break.

E-1534.title: Rejection-wick break bar fade
E-1534.hypothesis: A bar that closes beyond the box edge but in the lower (upper) part of its own range was sold (bought) back hard inside the same bar; the breakout buyers met supply above the edge and are already losing on most of their fills, so fade the break.

E-1535.title: Volume-ebb box break fade
E-1535.hypothesis: When the last few bars trade fewer contracts than the box's average bar, participation is draining as price drifts to the edge; a break made into that ebb is thin quotes being lifted, not an initiator, and the resting size of the box takes it back, so fade it.

E-1536.title: Tight-for-the-time box break fade
E-1536.hypothesis: A short box much narrower than the usual box at this minute of day means makers are quoting tight with little to absorb; a close beyond it covers few points and only reaches the next layer of their quotes, so it rotates back; fade breaks of boxes tight for the time of day.

E-1537.title: Rejected outside-open day box-break fade
E-1537.hypothesis: A session that opens outside yesterday's range and then trades back inside it has rejected the overnight move; the gap traders are trapped and the market returns to yesterday's balance, where both sides trade the edges, so short box breaks after the return are faded.
